texts.orig: If B = h c is a standard projective additive, the composition k [Υ add ] ◦ Θ A,B is equal to Υ , hence Θ A,B is an isomorphism in this case. Finite direct sums of standard projective additives are isomorphic to standard projective additives, hence Θ A,B is also an isomorphism if B is a finite direct sum of standard additive projectives. Now the source and the target of Θ A,B , viewed as functors of B preserve filtered colimits of monomorphisms, which implies in turn that Θ A,B is an isomorphism if B is an arbitrary direct sum of standard projective additives.
